DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) secondary to chronic arsenic or heavy metal exposure from rice farming.

The combination of blistering pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy (tingling in palms), and your occupation in rice farming strongly suggests PCT caused by heavy metal accumulation.
